name: cmux.newtab/1
docs: A New Tab view: the app's scene draws in a slot over cmux's own New Tab composer, never in its place; the composer, the rows and the page stay cmux's. It shows only when the person names the app in the setting tabs.newTabApp (Settings > Tabs > New Tab App, or Use as New Tab in the Apps page); unset, cmux draws its page with no slot. When the named app is missing, disabled, hidden, its render fails or it does not draw within 2 s, the slot stays empty for that visit and nothing else changes. The render export gets the mount context ({surface: "newTab", cwd?}: the folder the new tab starts in). It mounts once per New Tab page and stays mounted while the page lives, also behind another tab; it unmounts when the tab becomes something else. Clicks run the node's onTap with the app's own scopes: open the tab the person wants with cmux.actions.run from a click (actions:run). The web New Tab page draws it; the native New Tab page (tabs.nativeNewTabPage) does not. A node with .opens({chat: key}) or .opens({closed: id}) asks cmux to open that chat or reopen that Recently Closed item through its own path; otherwise its onTap runs. Icon("harness:<id>") and Row({ symbol: "harness:<id>" }) draw the agent's mark.
status: draft: shapes are refined with the first implementing app before the interface is public
